{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} module ContainerOrchestrator where import Data.Text (Text) import qualified Data.Text as T import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE import Data.ByteString (ByteString) import qualified Data.ByteString as BS import qualified Data.ByteString.Base64 as B64 import Crypto.Cipher.AES (AES256) import Crypto.Cipher.Types (cipherInit, cbcEncrypt, cbcDecrypt, makeIV, IV) import Crypto.Error (CryptoFailable(..)) import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe) import Data.Aeson (ToJSON(..), object, (.=)) import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map -- | Container metadata stored in encrypted storage data ContainerMeta = ContainerMeta { cmId :: Text , cmName :: Text , cmLabels :: Map.Map Text Text , cmStatusMsg :: Text -- user-provided status annotation , cmOwner :: Text } deriving (Show) -- | Encrypted storage layer -- NOTE: Each stored ciphertext MUST carry its own unique IV as the first -- 16 bytes; a single shared IV must never be reused across records. data EncryptedStore = EncryptedStore { esKey :: ByteString , esData :: Map.Map Text ByteString -- value = 16-byte IV || ciphertext } -- | Dashboard rendering context data RenderContext = RenderContext { rcTrustedOrigins :: [Text] , rcEnableCSP :: Bool , rcNonce :: Text } -- | Sanitize text for HTML output - strips dangerous tags sanitizeHtml :: Text -> Text sanitizeHtml input = let stripped = T.replace "" "" stripped stripped3 = T.replace "javascript:" "" stripped2 stripped4 = T.replace "onerror" "" stripped3 stripped5 = T.replace "onload" "" stripped4 in stripped5 -- | Encode text for safe embedding in HTML attributes attrEncode :: Text -> Text attrEncode input = T.replace "&" "&" $ T.replace "\"" """ $ T.replace "'" "'" $ T.replace "<" "<" $ T.replace ">" ">" input -- | Render container status widget for the orchestration dashboard -- This generates an HTML fragment that gets embedded in the SPA renderStatusWidget :: RenderContext -> ContainerMeta -> Text renderStatusWidget ctx meta = let safeId = attrEncode (cmId meta) safeName = attrEncode (cmName meta) safeOwner = attrEncode (cmOwner meta) -- Status message goes through sanitization for HTML body content safeStatus = sanitizeHtml (cmStatusMsg meta) in T.concat [ "
\n" , "

", safeName, "

\n" , "
", safeStatus, "
\n" , " \n" , "
\n" ] -- | Build JSON payload for client-side status rendering -- The rendered field contains pre-processed HTML from the encrypted store buildStatusJson :: ContainerMeta -> Text buildStatusJson meta = let labels = cmLabels meta -- Retrieve the 'display-template' label if present template = Map.findWithDefault "" "display-template" labels -- Apply template substitution for the status message rendered = applyTemplate template (cmStatusMsg meta) in T.concat [ "{\"id\":\"" , jsStringEscape (cmId meta) , "\",\"status\":\"" , jsStringEscape (cmStatusMsg meta) , "\",\"rendered\":\"" , jsStringEscape rendered , "\"}" ] -- | Apply a display template, substituting {{status}} with the message applyTemplate :: Text -> Text -> Text applyTemplate template status | T.null template = sanitizeHtml status | otherwise = sanitizeHtml (T.replace "{{status}}" (attrEncode status) template) -- | Escape text for embedding in JavaScript string literals jsStringEscape :: Text -> Text jsStringEscape input = T.replace "\\" "\\\\" $ T.replace "\"" "\\\"" $ T.replace "\n" "\\n" $ T.replace "\r" "\\r" $ T.replace "\t" "\\t" $ T.replace "/" "\\/" $ T.replace "<" "\\u003c" $ T.replace ">" "\\u003e" input -- | Decrypt container metadata from the encrypted store -- The stored value is (16-byte IV || ciphertext); the IV is unique per record -- and never reused, avoiding CBC IV-reuse weaknesses. decryptContainerMeta :: EncryptedStore -> Text -> Maybe ContainerMeta decryptContainerMeta store containerId = do stored <- Map.lookup containerId (esData store) let (ivBytes, encData) = BS.splitAt 16 stored if BS.length ivBytes < 16 || BS.null encData then Nothing else do iv <- makeIV ivBytes :: Maybe (IV AES256) let cipher = cipherInit (esKey store) :: CryptoFailable AES256 case cipher of CryptoFailed _ -> Nothing CryptoPassed c -> do let decrypted = cbcDecrypt c iv encData parseContainerMeta (TE.decodeUtf8 decrypted) -- | Parse decrypted metadata (simplified) parseContainerMeta :: Text -> Maybe ContainerMeta parseContainerMeta raw = let fields = T.splitOn "\x01" raw in case fields of [cid, name, owner, status, labelsRaw] -> Just $ ContainerMeta cid name (parseLabels labelsRaw) status owner _ -> Nothing -- | Parse label map from serialized form parseLabels :: Text -> Map.Map Text Text parseLabels raw = let pairs = T.splitOn "\x02" raw parsePair p = case T.splitOn "=" p of [k, v] -> Just (k, v) _ -> Nothing in Map.fromList $ fromMaybe [] (mapM parsePair pairs) -- | Main dashboard render entry point renderDashboard :: EncryptedStore -> RenderContext -> [Text] -> Text renderDashboard store ctx containerIds = let widgets = map (\cid -> case decryptContainerMeta store cid of Nothing -> "
Container not found
" Just meta -> renderStatusWidget ctx meta ) containerIds in T.concat [ "\n" , "\n" , "\n" , T.concat widgets , "" ]
